messages:
Ethan: Quick heads-up  I'm running a small pass to standardize SDK snippets: rename local var `result` -> `response` in examples, use `model_version` in code samples, and replace 'cache warming' with 'prefetch' in copy. Opening tiny PRs for py/js/go.

Priya: Sounds good. Add a one-line parenthetical under each snippet: (note: `response` is a client param, not the raw API payload). That prevented confusion before.

Noah: Linter reminder: make sure fenced code blocks include the language tag (```python, ```js). MDX playground fails on untagged blocks and unescaped backticks. I'll run the linter pre-merge.

Alina: Voice note: UI copy should read "model version" (two words) while code uses `model_version`. Also prefer active captions like "Fetch an embedding". I'll review voice/terminology.

docs-bot: Glossary v2: preferred term is "prefetch". Automated link-checker: 3 broken links in /docs/samples (see #eng-docs).

Ethan: Great, thanks. I'll label PRs `docs:migration`, `needs-glossary-review`, `needs-voice-approval` and include this note in the PR description: "examples-only rename; no API contract changes." Target review: 5 business days.

Priya: I'll take Python. Noah can do JS. Alina will do voice checks.

Noah: On it. I'll include a tiny unit-style test where feasible and run the link-checker locally before pushing.

Ethan: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4380 (py), /pull/4381 (js), /pull/4382 (go). Ping here for quick reviews.

Alina: Reviewing now. If anything fuzzy, I'll comment rather than block.

Priya: Reviewing after lunch. Thanks team. :rocket:
